name: Camp Timanous
description_short: Boys' summer camp in Raymond, Maine, with a seven-week full season or two half sessions. Tuition covers activities such as woodshop, crafts, waterskiing and camping trips, plus laundry, health insurance and the yearbook.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund of all money paid, minus a $200 administrative fee, through March 1. After that, refunds are made only if another camper fills the spot. Tuition insurance (Program Protector) is available through CampMinder.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterskiing is listed among the activities covered by tuition. The page gives no other swim or waterfront details.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page does not say directly that campers stay overnight. Sleepaway is inferred from the seven-week season, laundry and health insurance being included, and a separate summer address.
Contact email is hidden on the page and could not be recorded.
Footer copyright reads 2024, but the schedule and rates are labeled 2027.
Discounts: early bird ($200 full season / $100 half season) if registered by October 31; sibling discount of 5% off the 2nd son and 10% off each additional son. Prices recorded are before discounts.
Extra costs not in tuition: transportation, uniforms, baggage charges, optional tutoring.
Payment schedule: $1,000 deposit at registration, $2,000 due February 1, balance due April 1.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
